annotations.title: Get the alignment of the couple

description: Returns the alignment steps of the prenup with the status of the customer and of the partner, the current step, and the data of a step as its app page shows it. The steps go in this order: financial-views (the customer agrees with the partner on each financial view), partners-premarital-property (the customer reads the premarital property of the partner), partners-postmarital-property (the customer agrees or disagrees with each postmarital allocation of the partner), and postmarital-property (the customer sees the review of the partner, and picks again where the partner disagrees). Give step to read a different step, or premarital-property or shared-property for the own premarital assets and the shared assets. Each asset and item gives its allocation in separate_property, as the page shows it. When ready_to_complete is true, the customer can complete alignment with complete_alignment. changed_after_completion names the sections that a partner changed after their completion. Tell the customer about them before a write of financial-views: the write clears the list, as the page does when it opens. Show the data to the customer before each write of the step. A question with in_app true changes only in the app: give the customer its app_url.

step.description: The step or the page to read. Leave it out for the current step.

name: get_alignment

allocation_labels.description: The words of the app for separate_property true and false.

changed_after_completion.description: The titles of the sections that the customer or the partner changed after their completion. The title of a partner section speaks to the partner.

complete_statement.description: Only when ready_to_complete is true, for Lawyer Review: show it before complete_alignment, and get an explicit yes.

current_step.description: The first step that the customer can do now.

data.description: The data of shown_step, as its app page shows it.

ready_to_complete.description: Each step is complete for both partners.

shown_step.description: The step or the page of data.

waiting_for_partner.description: Why the customer waits for the partner.

title: Get the alignment of the couple
